title: Sessions panel: move the foreground/background split into the STATUS control ('Working sessions (3) · 1 foreground / 2 background')
outcome: The working-session count shows its foreground/background split inside the STATUS control itself, as 'Working sessions (3) · 1 foreground / 2 background', with an accessible explanation (tooltip / aria description). The ambiguous standalone '1 foreground · 2 background' text next to the cards is removed. The counts and their meaning are unchanged.
acceptance: The STATUS control renders 'Working sessions (N) · F foreground / B background' (or the compact '(F/B)' form at narrow widths, with the full text in a tooltip and accessible description); the separate standalone split text next to the cards is gone; covered by Vitest tests including zero-background and zero-foreground cases.
Counts and semantics are unchanged from master; `npx tsc --noEmit` is clean; affected Vitest suites pass; an independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding.
